name: Value-State and Outcome Semantics
classification_question: Does the obligation determine the domain meaning assigned to a value, omission, transformation, default state, or observable outcome, independently of how that result is delivered?

name: Reference, Eligibility, Choice, and Ordering
classification_question: Does the obligation establish the referent or apply the domain relation that validates, selects, orders, prioritizes, authorizes, or admits a candidate, source, result, target, or effect?

name: State Mutation, Synchronization, and Ownership
classification_question: Does the obligation constrain how authoritative, dependent, persisted, aliased, caller-owned, or operation-owned state may change or remain isolated?

name: Operation Lifecycle Responsibility
classification_question: Does the obligation govern a transfer of lifecycle responsibility: entry only after prerequisites are ready, settlement after work is accepted, or closure of operation-owned resources when ownership ends?

name: Cross-Boundary Contract and Propagation
classification_question: Does the obligation establish or preserve a consumer-recognized binding, identity, message, diagnostic, policy, provenance relation, or permitted output across a component, stage, representation, locale, origin, or disclosure boundary?

name: Evolution and Supported-Coverage Relation
classification_question: Is comparison with established non-target behavior or the complete supported target-variant set itself constitutive of the omission witness?

name: Observation and Collection Projection
classification_question: Does the obligation determine whether observations, attribution, counts, membership, windows, continuation, or traversal truthfully project authoritative events or collection state?

name: Work and State Amplification Bounds
classification_question: Does the obligation constrain the relation between logical input or observed variety and generated work, capacity demand, or persistent identity/state growth?

name: Consumer-Reconstructable and Presentation Structure
classification_question: Does the obligation determine machine- or human-consumable structure, geometry, direction, hierarchy, navigation, or reachability of presented or model-exposed content?
